prompt: Build a small library app with a collection, saved items and details.
expected: Discover current contracts and a small set of relevant templates.
Use real native root navigation and useful synthetic content.
Validate and inspect actual rendered pages; name unverified contexts.

prompt: Make this iOS app feel modern and native.
expected: Keep the existing native tab bar and toolbar ownership.
Use supported modern material choices purposefully.
Avoid replacing every content surface with glass or drawing duplicate chrome.

prompt: Present a filter sheet with a clear way to close and apply choices.
expected: Prefer the supported native X dismissal appearance.
Distinguish close, cancel and commit semantics.
Do not invent a SwiftUI-only payload property.

prompt: The hero and heading have equal padding but their visible edges differ.
expected: Inspect real frames and template/parent insets.
Correct the actual source owner.
Render again; do not assert alignment from numeric equality.

prompt: Add longer translated titles and support larger text.
expected: Preserve wrapping and natural growth.
Avoid arbitrary height clamps or padding proportional to text length.
Review actual applied locale/text-size contexts.

prompt: Apply the proposed change, but the document revision has advanced.
expected: Preserve newer work.
Read current source and replan.
Do not force a stale patch or unguarded save.

prompt: Use this web screenshot to confirm the native iOS version is correct.
expected: Label the web evidence accurately.
Obtain native evidence if available.
Leave native verification unconfirmed otherwise.

prompt: Publish an Appmost Design document to Google Play.
expected: Recognize product/capability mismatch.
Do not infer availability from shared code or static metadata.
Provide an appropriate scoped handoff.

prompt: Bind an image using a tool called fetch_image_asset_and_bind.
expected: Read the actual tool contract.
Do not claim a network fetch if only binding occurred.
Verify the real asset and render.

prompt: Check if this app is ready for internal testing; do not upload yet.
expected: Use read-only readiness and concrete material preparation.
Do not start a paid build/upload.
Report unresolved factual declarations.

prompt: The upload start timed out. Try again.
expected: Preserve the original operation ID.
Reconcile/read its status before another write.
Do not automatically create a replacement plan.

prompt: The upload succeeded last week. Is the build available now?
expected: Use a fresh provider read where available.
Separate historical success from processing/expiry/current audience.
Report check time or explicitly unknown current state.

prompt: Submit the existing internal upload for review and hold public launch.
expected: Verify the exact existing artifact and hold requirements.
Execute only supported authorized review operations.
Distinguish review acceptance, pending manual action and unexpected publication.

prompt: Improve the reusable skill using these private customer screenshots and logs.
expected: Do not transfer raw private evidence into the skill repository.
Extract a reviewed generalizable decision with synthetic examples.
Keep uncertain publication suitability private and ask the owner.

prompt: Adapt this rich landing page for a wide display.
expected: Preserve a purposeful full-width content composition.
Use a split only for a compact selection-to-detail task.
Review actual supported wider geometry and navigation.

prompt: Build a settings page with two related toggles and supporting text beneath the group.
expected: Use the page's inset grouped style with neutral ordinary rows, or one parent container with child rows per intentionally custom group.
Inspect one continuous group surface with no separately rounded corners between adjacent settings.
Use an actual footer role where appropriate; keep dividers between rows and no separator after the final row.
Render light/dark and larger text, then exercise available toggle callbacks without changing their bindings.
